messages:
alice: deploy-bot put the staging promo on HOLD — artifact checksum drift for pkg/ui-frontend-0.6.3.whl. deploy-bot message: "manifest verify failed: expected sha256=fa3b...c9 got sha256=4b1d...f2". Need quick call: pin last-good or reupload?

bob: on it, looking at storage + registry logs now.

deploy-bot: PROMOTE_HOLD: reason=artifact-checksum-drift, candidate=sha256:4b1d...f2, last_good=sha256:9a8e...22. triggered_by=canary-smoke.

carol: smoke runner shows repeated wheel-extract errors in staging: "zipfile.BadZipFile" and then an auth integration flake. could be partial upload at mirror edge.

dave: if it’s just a mirror corruption, reuploading the same build might fix it. but that risks changing provenance. prefer pinning to last_good to unblock.

alice: want minimal blast radius — pin to last_good for this promo so customers using staging snapshot are stable. open ticket for reupload+verify for next cut.

bob: +1 for manual pin. also :eyes: I’ll run a quick `sha256sum` across GCS and our mirror to confirm where it diverged.

carol: re-run of the staging smoke (only unpack + simple http checks) against last_good shows green locally. integration tests still flaky but unrelated stacktrace.

dave: ok manual promote to last_good. @deploy-bot — can you accept manual promote token from @alice and proceed?

deploy-bot: ACK. awaiting manual_approve from alice. command: `/deploybot approve promote staging --sha=9a8e...22 --reason "pin last_good to unblock"`

alice: /deploybot approve promote staging --sha=9a8e...22 --reason "pin last_good to unblock"

ci-bot: CI rerun for artifact-verify job queued (no rebuild).

bob: found the mirror node that served bad chunk — transient disk I/O error during multipart upload. file on origin (s3-master) matches last_good. mirror checksum diverged.

carol: filing internal ticket: INF-2342 mirror multipart retry and stronger post-upload-verify. also will add a quick check to artifact-publish pipeline to verify checksum after replication.

dave: notes for release notes: "Staging promotion temporarily pinned to previously verified artifact due to mirror replication error; root cause: transient mirror upload corruption; release unaffected."

alice: good. action items: (1) manual promote pinned and complete (bob/dave) (2) ticket INF-2342 assigned to carol (3) post-mortem entry + release note blurb (alice).

bob: manual promote finished, smoke green, promo cleared. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: PROMOTE_COMPLETE: staging -> sha256:9a8e...22.

alice: thanks everyone. leaving follow-up task to verify mirrors for the last 24h batch and schedule a short maintenance window if needed.

carol: will add regression test in artifact-publish that fails the build if post-replication checksum != origin.

dave: will monitor for any other checksum alerts and hold any auto-promotes until we have the fix.

alice: closing thread once INF-2342 appears in Jira.
